final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response is a narrower and more accurate interpretation of the same record: aggregate readiness passed, rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, the clinical-coding slice remains below target, the draft mitigation is incomplete, and policy requires disclosure or approved mitigation/risk acceptance for unresolved material limitations. That narrowing matters analytically, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat is still an unfulfilled compliance predicate rather than a satisfied condition. In particular, there is still no admissible evidence that the limitation has been explicitly disclosed in the final release artifact, no approved mitigation meeting the policy fields, and no approved risk acceptance. On this record, aggregate launch readiness supports a monitored-launch rationale in principle, but the current certification basis remains incomplete under policy.
